summary: Goldelm’s first-property configuration should prioritize an online application with integrated payments, rentable add-ons, automatic proration, controlled renewals, and make-ready-based availability. The calls establish clear operational needs, but an accounting discovery session and several property-specific policy decisions are still required before configuration is final.

settings.proposed: Set up an online application that collects the application fee and required income documents before submission.
settings.meaning: Prospects complete and pay for the application online instead of staff processing paper applications, payment forms, and supporting documents separately.
settings.assumption: The first property will follow the demonstrated online workflow; screening criteria and exact fees still require confirmation.
reasoning: Goldelm said most applications are currently paper-based and manually entered.
Its newer website accepts an application but cannot collect the application fee, causing prospects to abandon the process.
The client agreed that requiring payment and document upload within the application would improve completion and reduce staff effort.
